answer: A durable defence is tiered, time-tested reputation. A new agent starts at a copper tier with strict rate limits and must post a small refundable bond. Only after sustained useful work over a long horizon, with no fraud, does it graduate to a jade tier with higher limits and rewards. An attacker who spawns many fake agents must pay the bond and repeat the slow work for each one, while any cheating forfeits the bond and resets that identity to zero, so mass forgery costs far more than it can earn.
